anger: A short pause or a change of scene may help you make room for what you are feeling.
disgust: Notice what felt uncomfortable today; naming it can make it easier to reflect on.
fear: Try writing down one thing you know for sure and one small next step.
joy: You might note what contributed to this brighter moment so you can remember it.
neutral: A steady day counts too. Keep checking in without needing every entry to feel significant.
sadness: Consider reaching out to someone you trust or choosing one gentle thing for yourself today.
surprise: Take a moment to reflect on what caught you off guard and how you feel about it now.
